name: Bvlgari Hotel Beijing
positioning: Urban Bvlgari hotel in Beijing's Embassy District, set along the Liangma River and designed by ACPV Architects
best_for: Travelers who want a spa and an indoor swim in a city hotel
Diners who want a Michelin-starred Italian restaurant on site

facts.text: The hotel is in Beijing's Embassy District, set along the Liangma River.
The riverside gardens are curated by Swiss landscape architect Enzo Enea.
The spa occupies two floors and features treatments blended with traditional Chinese techniques.
The spa has steam and sauna facilities.
The gym has Technogym and Kinesis equipment, with an adjacent movement studio and Pilates.
The gym is open 24 hours a day for hotel guests.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito has custom-designed Barovier & Toso glass chandeliers.
Chef Niko Romito personally trained the chefs of the Il Ristorante - Niko Romito restaurants.

highlights.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Beijing for six consecutive years since 2020.
The hotel is housed within the Genesis Beijing, beside the Genesis Art Gallery designed by Tadao Ando.
The Bvlgari Spa has a 25-metre mosaic-tiled pool inspired by the ancient Terme di Caracalla.
ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel was responsible for the entire interior and exterior design.
The Bvlgari Bar serves cocktails, fine wine and champagne during Aperitivo Hour at the oval bar or on the outdoor terrace overlooking the riverside.

considerations.text: The hotel is a city base in the Embassy District, housed within the Genesis Beijing, rather than a beach or resort setting.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
